title: #32. Bannu Mustalaq & T.B.O. Trench
arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ ۝ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته

رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي۝وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي۝وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي۝يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي۝

Ayesha رضي الله عنها said; يَرْحَمْكِ الله كَيْفَ تِيْكُمْ تَعِسَ مِسْطَحٌ Ayesha رضي الله عنها said; Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; إِنَّ الَّذِينَ جَاءُوا بِالْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌ مِنْكُمْ ۚ

لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا لَكُمْ ۖ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ ۚ لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ مَا اكْتَسَبَ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ ۚ وَالَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ كِبْرَهُ مِنْهُمْ لَهُ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ۝

لَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتُ بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًا وَقَالُوا هَٰذَا إِفْكٌ مُبِينٌ۝

لَوْلَا جَاءُوا عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ ۚ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِالشُّهَدَاءِ فَأُولَٰئِكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ۝

وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَرَحْمَتُهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِي مَا أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ ۝

إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ مَا لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ۝

وَلَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُمْ مَا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَنْ نَتَكَلَّمَ بِهَٰذَا سُبْحَانَكَ هَٰذَا بُهْتَانٌ عَظِيمٌ۝

يَعِظُكُمُ اللَّهُ أَنْ تَعُودُوا لِمِثْلِهِ أَبَدًا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ ۝

وَيُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ۝

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَنْ تَشِيعَ الْفَاحِشَةُ فِي الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ ۚ

وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ۝

وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ۝

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ ۚ وَمَنْ يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ ۚ

وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًا وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يُزَكِّي مَنْ يَشَاءُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ۝

وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُولُو الْفَضْلِ مِنْكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ أَنْ يُؤْتُوا أُولِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينَ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ

وَلْيَعْفُوا وَلْيَصْفَحُوا ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ۝

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْغَافِلَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ لُعِنُوا لُعِنُوا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ ۝

يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ۝

يَوْمَئِذٍ يُوَفِّيهِمُ اللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ الْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِينُ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ said; Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً

وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا لَهُمْ شَهَادَةً أَبَدًا ۚ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ۝

اِنَّه’كَانَ الَّذِيْ حَزَّبَ الْاَحْزَابَ نَفَرً مِّنَّ الْيَهُوْدْ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا نَصِيبًا مِنَ الْكِتَابِ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوتِ وَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا هَٰؤُلَاءِ أَهْدَىٰ

وَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا هَٰؤُلَاءِ أَهْدَىٰ مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا سَبِيلًاَ ۝

أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ ۖ وَمَنْ يَلْعَنِ اللَّهُ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُ نَصِيرًاَ۝

يَا رَسُوْل الله، اِنَّ اِذَ كُنَّا بِاَرْضِ الْفَارِسْ وَتَخَوَّفْنَا الْخَيْلْ، خَنْدَقْنَا عَلَيْنَا فَهَل لَّكَ يَا رَسُوْل الله اَنْ تُخَنْدِقْ

لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمَ الْاَحْزَابِ وَخَنْدَقَ رَسُوْلُ الله صَلى الله عليه وسلم رَاَيْتُه، يَنْقُلْ مِنْ تَرَابِ الْخَنْدَقْ حَتَّى وَارِى عَنِّيْ اَلْغُبَارْ جِلْدَةَ بَطْنِه

إِذْ جَاءُوكُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ الْأَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِاللَّهِ الظُّنُونَا۝

وَلَمَّا رَأَى الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ قَالُوا هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَصَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ۚ وَمَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا إِيمَانًا وَتَسْلِيمًاَ۝

فَأَوْجَسَ فِي نَفْسِهِ خِيفَةً مُوسَىٰ وَإِذْ قَالَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ يَا أَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَارْجِعُوا ۚ وَيَسْتَأْذِنُ فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمُ النَّبِيَّ يَقُولُونَ

يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ وَمَا هِيَ بِعَوْرَةٍ ۖ إِنْ يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًا۝

وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوا الْفِتْنَةَ لَآتَوْهَا لَآتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا بِهَا إِلَّا يَسِيرًا۝

وَلَقَدْ كَانُوا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ الْأَدْبَارَ ۚ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ اللَّهِ مَسْئُولًاَ۝

قُلْ لَنْ يَنْفَعَكُمُ الْفِرَارُ إِنْ فَرَرْتُمْ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ أَوِ الْقَتْلِ وَإِذًا لَا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًاَ۝

قُلْ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْصِمُكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً ۚ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا۝

قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَالْقَائِلِينَ لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ هَلُمَّ إِلَيْنَا ۖ وَلَا يَأْتُونَ الْبَأْسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًاَ

أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ الْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِي يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ ۖ

فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُمْ بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا فَأَحْبَطَ اللَّهُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًاَ۝

يَحْسَبُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا ۖ وَإِنْ يَأْتِ الْأَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّوا لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ بَادُونَ فِي الْأَعْرَابِ يَسْأَلُونَ عَنْ أَنْبَائِكُمْ ۖ

وَلَوْ كَانُوا فِيكُمْ مَا قَاتَلُوا إِلَّا قَلِيلاً۝

كَانَ لَيْلُنَا بِالْخَنْدَقِ نَهَارًا صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا
english:
The Life of Muhammadﷺ, The Madinan Period, Volume 1 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki, During the battle of Bannu Mustallaq(بنو مصطلق), an important incident occurred,

and its importance lies in the great lessons that the Ummah(امة) learned from this, unfortunate incident.

We'll let Ayesha رضي الله عنها relate to us the story of what happened.?

These narrations by the way, I mentioned are in Bukhari(بخاريْ), Muslim(مسلم), Ibn Is'haaq(ابن اسحاق).

She said: When the Messenger of Allah was about to go on a journey.

He would draw lots among his wives to decide, who would accompany him, he did so as usual for the expedition against Bannu Al-Mustallaq(بنوالمصطلق).

My name was drawn and so he took me with him.

The women on such occasions would eat lights filling foods, and they would be lightweight.

In those days, Ayesha رضي الله عنها said that we used to eat very light meals, so we were lightweight.

I would sit in my Haudaj(هودج), while my camel was being saddled, this Haudaj(هودج) is a closed space.

And it is put on top of the camel for women to sit in.

It's made out of wood and then they cover it, so women could be sitting in there without her being seen.

The men responsible for mounting it, would then grasp the Haudaj(هودج) from below it and lift it and place it upon the camel's back, tying it there with ropes,

they would then lead the camel away by the head.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ had completed that journey, he directed the party to return home.

And when close to Madina, he made a halt for part of the night, a crier then called out to everyone to depart again.

And people prepared to do so.

I went out to relieve myself.

I was wearing a necklace of onyx beads from Dafaar(دفار) when I had finished, it slipped from my neck without my knowledge, having returned to my mount I felt for it around my neck but didn't find it there.

But people were beginning to leave, so I returned to where I had been to search for the necklace and eventually I found it.

It was right under the place she was sitting.

The man who had now finished saddling my camel, came back for me and raised up the Haudaj(هودج) thinking I was inside as usual.

You see, because she was very lightweight, they didn't tell the difference that she wasn't in there and fasten it on to the camel, they had no doubts about me being inside.

Then they took the camel by the head and lead it away.

When I returned to the campsite.

There was absolutely no one there, everyone had left.

So, I wrapped myself in my cloak and lay down, I was sure that they would return for me, when they miss me.

I swear I was lying there , when Safwaan Ibn Muattalb As-Sulami(صفوان ابن المعطل السلمي) came by.

He had for some reason of his own being lagging behind the other warriors and had not spent the night with the others.

When he saw my form, he approached and stood over me.

He had seen me before the veil was required for us.

When he saw me he exclaimed; To Allah we belong and to Him we return.

Isn't it Zaeenah(ظعينة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.?

Zaeenah(ظعينة) is the term used to refer to a woman, who was sitting in the Haudaj(هودج).

I was all wrapped up, in my cloak.

He then asked what made you stay behind, May Allah, have mercy on you, I did not speak to him.

He then brought up the camel and said you ride.

He kept away from me.

So, I mounted, and he led the camel away by the head, moving quickly to catch up with the rest.

I swear by Allah we neither caught them up, nor did they miss me before morning.

So the entire night, they didn't miss her and they weren't able to catch up with the army.

By the time the forest had halted and made secure.

The man appeared leading me.

And so those who spread the calumny began talking, and the men were greatly perturbed.

However I swear I knew nothing of this.

So, now this man, Safwaan(صفوان) leading the camel and Ayesha(عائشه) is riding on it appears, and the Muslims, see what is happening, they see that Safwaan(صفوان) and Ayesha(عائشه) are coming alone.

So they start, spreading rumors, saying that why were they together and accusing Ayesha رضي الله عنها.

We then went on to Madina.

There I soon fell seriously sick and heard nothing of what was going on.

See all of these rumors are spreading around and Ayesha(عائشه) has no idea about it, all the talk soon reached Rasool Allah ﷺ and my parents,

but they told me absolutely nothing of this.

All I noticed was that Rasool Allah ﷺ was not as kind as usual towards me.

Whenever I had been sick he had been very kind and comforting to me, but not on this occasion.

I pretended not to notice.

When he came in to see me, my mother being present nursing me, he would just say formally.

Which means, how is she.?

He wouldn't even speak to her.

He would add, nothing more.

Eventually this coldness of his bothered me and so I asked him, O Rasool Ullah if you will allow it I'd like to go and stay with my mother to have her, care for me.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said, No problem.

And so I moved in with my mother.

I still had no knowledge, what was going on until I recovered from my illness some three weeks later.

So for three weeks, she has no idea that this rumor is spreading around about her.

She said: We were an Arab people and did not have in our homes those toilets that foreigners use.

We find them disgusting.

We would go out and use the open areas of Madina.

Each night the women would go outside to relieve themselves.

I went out to do so one night accompanied by Umm Mustakh(ام مسطح), daughter of Abu Room Al-Muttalib(ابو روم المطلب).

She was walking with me when she tripped over her gown and swore, Means perish, that Mustakh(مسطح), Mutakh(مسطح) was her son's nickname has real name being Auf(عوف).

I commented, that's a terrible thing to say about a Mohajer(مهاجر), and a man who fought at Badr(بدر).

So, Ayesha(عائشه) here is saying, Why are you saying this about your son.?

And your son is a Muhajir(مهاجر) and he has attended Badr(بدر).

So, this shows you that attending Badr(بدر) was a special thing.

So, the mother of Mutakh(مسطح) said; Has the news not reached you, daughter of Abu Bakr(ابو بكر).

I said: What news.?

She then told me, what those spreading the calumny were saying, so I exclaim, This is really so.

She said, Yes, it is really so.

Ayesha(عائشه) says, I swear, I was so upset.

I could not do my business and went home.

I wept so much, I thought my crying would burst my liver.

I told my mother; May Allah forgive you for not telling me, anything about what the people have been saying about me.

She said: Don't take it too seriously daughter.

Rarely does a beautiful woman with a husband who loves her not have her co-wives and others too, speak badly about her.

O messenger of Allah, why don't we dig a moat, a trench.

Rasool Allah ﷺ and the Muslims, liked the idea, and the project started.

Now, it would have been impossible for them to dig this moat, all around Madina, because they just didn't have the manpower for that, so they had to choose the locations which were vulnerable.

Now that location was north of Madina, which would sound strange because Makkah is to the south, but the thing is that Madina, had a natural protection from the east and west,

and that was what is called, Al-Harrah(الحرة), these are volcanic tracks, tracks of volcanic rock, very sharp, very edgy and boulders all over, so it's difficult for an army to march through.

And then from the south, you have the dwellings, the farmland, which also makes it difficult to penetrate.

So, the danger is from the north.

And that's where, they dug the trench.

Every 10 men were given 40 feet of land to dig.

And they split into groups and they start the work.

It was very difficult, The Muslims were hungry, they were poor, there was lack of food.

And there was lack of numbers too, to dig this trench.

Anas Ibn Malik رضي الله عنه, he said the Messenger of Allah went out to the trench and found that the Muhajiroon(مهاجرون) and the Ansaar(انصار) were busy digging.

It was a very cold morning, and they had no slaves to do that work for them.

When he saw, what they were suffering from, the hard labor and their hunger, he said; O Allah, their life is indeed that of the afterlife, forgive the Ansaar(انصار) and the Muhajiroon(مهاجرون).

They're having difficulty in Duniyah(دنيا), but their life doesn't belong to this world, it belongs to the afterlife.

Rasool Allah ﷺ himself participated in the digging.

Al-Bara'a(البرآء) narrates in Al-Bukhari(البخاريْ), On the day of Al-Ahzaad(احزاب), when Rasool Allah ﷺ was digging the trench, I saw him, carrying dirt, until there was so much dirt on his stomach, I couldn't see his skin anymore.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was right there with his followers in the field, working with them.

This is the leadership example that Rasool Allah ﷺ is giving us.

He wasn't aloof from the people, he wouldn't treat himself specially, he was trying to be one of them.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ was the best of humanity صلى الله عليه وسلم.

Rasool Allah ﷺ would get so hungry, he would have to tie a stone to his stomach.

You know to suppress the hunger to elevate the pain, he would tie this rock to his stomach that was how difficult it was on him and how hungry, he صلى الله عليه وسلم was.

But his spirit was high, and he would elevate the spirits of the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم, and he would chant with them, so they would recite these lines of poetry,

and Rasool Allah ﷺ would go along with them and recite these words they would say, "O Allah, without you we would not have been well guided.....

nor would we have been charitable.....

Nor would we have prayed.....

so do send tranquility upon us.....

And make us stand firm, when we meet the foe.....

They have wronged us.....

If they want trouble, we will meet them.....

And Rasool Allah ﷺ would stretch the final words.

They're guards around the clock, guarding the trench and guarding Madina, and the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم would take turns in guarding the difficulties were increasing, rather than decreasing.

You have this army coming forward, made up of Quraish(قريش) and Ghatafaan(غطفان).

And then there was a very serious problem, and this couldn't have come in a worse time.

The dwellings of Bannu Quraidha(بنوقريظه).

The last Jewish tribe remaining in Madina, were part of the protection, were part of the plan of protection that Rasool Allah ﷺ had for Madina.

So, their fortresses were used as a protection from the army advancing from that area.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was receiving news that Bannu Quraidha(بنوقريظه), themselves were betraying their agreement with Rasool Allah ﷺ and were going to join with the Confederates.

This would have been a disaster because they were supposed to be part of the protection, So if that gate is opened, then the Muslims are going to be in serious trouble.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ send Al-Zubair Bin Awwam(الزبير بن عوام) to investigate the matter.

Al-Zubair Bin Awwam(الزبير بن عوام) brings back information that they are bringing in their livestock, and they are paving their roads, which is an indication of preparation for war.

Rasool Allah ﷺ wanted to investigate the matter further, so he sends Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ), Sa'ad Ibn Ubadah(سعد بن عباده), Abdullah Bin Rawaha(عبدالله بن رواحة) and Khawaat Bin Jubair(خوات بن جبير).

He told them, go and investigate the matter and bring me news of whether Quraidha( قريظه) have betrayed, or broken their agreement with me.

If that's the case, do not weaken the people come and deliver the news to me, secretly.

If you find that they are still up to their word and agreement, and they're keeping the agreement, then, make the news public.

And we can see here, the lesson, we learned a lesson here from Rasool Allah ﷺ that sometimes you want to keep away some news from the people.

If it's detrimental news, if it's a news that would demoralize them, if it would weaken them, it might be Muslaha(مصلحة) to keep it away from the army.

Rasool Allah ﷺ wanted to keep it secret, if that was the case.

But if it's good news that they are still keeping the agreement, then make it public.

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ), Sa'ad Ibn Ubadah(سعد بن عباده), Abdullah Bin Rawaha(عبدالله بن رواحة) and Khawaat(خوات بن جبير), they go there, they come back

and they tell Rasool Allah ﷺ two words.

Azal Wal Qarrah(عضل والقارة).

Azal Wal Qarrah(عضل والقارة), if you remember, are the two tribes that betrayed the men, whom were sent by Rasool Allah ﷺ, the ones who betrayed the men and killed them.

So, this was an indication from these men that Quraidha( قريظه) have broken the agreement and Rasool Allah ﷺ got the point, and made preparations for that.

Rasool Allah ﷺ sends out two groups, one 200 men, the other one 300 men as guards, and they would go around the area of Bannu Quraidha(بنوقريظه) to show them that we are still here,

and we're still strong, and we're willing to fight.

So, it was a show of strength, and the Muslims were able to intercept 20 Camel loads of Dates Figs and barley, that we're going towards the army of the Ahzaab(احزاب)

and their point of origin was Bannu Quraidha(بنوقريظه).

So, it makes it clear that Bannu Quraidha(بنوقريظه) have betrayed Rasool Allah ﷺ, they have committed treason.

They are now supplying the army of the enemy.

So, it was very difficult on the Muslims, extremely difficult, probably the most difficult situation, they've been through.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ describes it, to us. Allah says; Remember, when they came at you from above you, and from below you.

And when eyes shifted in fear and hearts reach to the throats, and you assumed about Allah various assumptions.

So here, the eyes were shifting in fear, you know there was this disorientation going on.

And Allah says that the hearts reached the throats which means that the hearts were pounding so fast.

It was as if you can feel it in your throat.

That was how difficult the situation was.

And you assumed about Allah various assumptions.

So, some people were making assumptions about the Allah, like Allah has promised us, in vain and that Allahعَزّوجَلّ will not give us victory

and that this religion is not true and we made a mistake, so all of these doubts were coming into the hearts and obviously the ones who are having these dangerous doubts in the religion were Munafiqoon(منافقون).

Allahعَزّوجَلّ also says and these Ayaat(آيات) are from Surat Ul Ahzaab(سورة الاحزاب).

And when the believers saw the companies, they said; This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us.

And Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth.

And it increased them only in faith and acceptance.

This was the response of the believers.

When the believers saw all of these dangers being thrown at them, that increased their Eeman(ايمان), rather than decreased it because they knew that Allahعَزّوجَلّ will test them,

so they saw this as part of the test.

Therefore, it only confirms what we already knew would happen.

But with the Munafiqeen(منافقين), it made them doubt even more, in the authenticity of Islam.

So, you can see how one event brought forth different reactions from the two camps, the believers and the non-believers.

See when it comes to fear, the fear was across the board, the believers were afraid and the Munafiqeen(منافقين) were afraid, but what is different is the reaction to that fear.

See fear is a natural human instinct, it is natural for human being to feel fear.

Musa عليه السّلام himself felt fear, Allahعَزّوجَلّ said that he felt fear in his heart.

But the thing is, with Musa عليه السّلام the fear was restricted to the heart.

It didn't show up on his actions, his actions were full of Eeman(ايمان).

So, that's the difference between Al-Mu'menoon(المؤمنون) and Al-Munafiqoon(منافقون).

The Munafiqoon(منافقون) acted negatively upon their fear, while the believers acted positively, they said this is what Allahعَزّوجَلّ has promised us, we expected this would happen.

Ibn Is'haaq(ابن اسحاق) said; There upon, the anxiety and fear increased their enemy came at them from above and below, so the Muslims were very confused

dissension arose, to the point where Muattib Bin Qushair(معتب بن قشير) commented, Muhammad(محمد) used to promise us that we would eat the treasures of Kisra(كسرى) and Caesar.

And now we don't even feel safe going to the toilet.

So, this is an example of the response of a Munafiq(منافق).

He said, what is Muhammadﷺ talking about?

Rasool Allah ﷺ and we will talk about this, when they were digging the trench.

He gave glad tidings that this Ummah(امة) would open the Persian Empire and the Roman Empire.

He said, What is Muhammad(محمد) talking about.?

We can't even feel safe going to the toilet and he's promising us, that we will conquer lands, thousands of kilometers away from us, and the Ayah(آية) of Qur'an described, Al-Munafiqoon(المنافقون) and I'll go through this Ayaat(آيات)

because these are the characteristics of Munafiqoon(منافقون) yesterday, and today, they don't change.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says, these are Ayaat(آيات) thirteen(13) through 20 in Surat Ul Ahzaab(سورة الاحزاب) And when a faction of them said; Oh, people of Yasrib(يثرب).

There's no stability for you here, so return home.

And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet saying, indeed, our houses are exposed, while they were not exposed they did not intend, except to flee.

So, the Munafiqoon(منافقون) here don't want to stay next to the trench.

They don't want to stay in the camp, they want to go back home and the excuse is, we need to go and defend the homes.

So, they pretending that they're going to go and fight, but Allahعَزّوجَلّ said, they did not intend except to flee.

That was their intention to run away.

And if they had been entered upon from all its surrounding regions and Fitnah(فتنة) had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it, except briefly.

This Ayah(آية) means that the Munafiqoon(منافقون), if they are pressured a bit, they're going to give up Islam, if the enemy asked them to become non Muslim, they're going to do that.

And they had already promised Allah before, not to turn their backs.

And ever is the promise to Allah questioned.

Say Never will fleeing benefit you, if you should flee from death or killing.

And then if you did, you would not be given enjoyment of life, except for a little.

This Aayah(آية), Allah is saying.

The meaning of the Aayah(آية), death is destined upon you.

So, running away from it, wouldn't change it, a bit.

Now let's assume that it's even going to change it.

How long are you going to live?

your life as a human being is very short.

So, what are you running away from.?

Then Allah says; Say, who is it that can protect you, from Allah.

If He intends for you an ill or intends for you, a mercy, and they will not find for themselves besides Allah, any protector, or any helper.

The Munafiqoon(منافقون) are looking for help, the wrong place.

They're looking for help from the Yahood(يهود), they're looking for help from Al-Kuffar(كفار).

Allah is saying, only Allah is An-Nafiah(النافع) and Adh-Dhaar(الضار) only Allah can benefit you and only Allah can harm you.

And then Allah says; Already, Allah knows the hinders among you, and those hypocrites, who say to their brothers.

Come to us, and do not go to battle except for a few, in disposed towards you.

And when fear comes, see this is the reaction when it's in times of difficulty, what do they do.?

And when fear comes, you see they looking at you.

Their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death, but when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, in disposed towards any good.

This is a quality of Nifaq(نفاق), in times of fear, their eyes are rotating, they're going around in circles because of fear, they're confused, they're afraid.

But when fear goes away, they're very loud, they talk a lot.

And then Allah says; Those have not believed, so Allah has rendered their deeds worthless and ever is that for Allah, easy.

Therefore, don't go by what people say in times of peace.

See, in times of peace, anybody and everybody can talk.

But what happens in times of difficulty, in times of Fitna(فتنه).

The Munafiqoon(منافقون) stay quiet, they're afraid they're terrified.

But when fear goes away they lash out, at everyone.

They start criticizing so and so, talking against so and so.

So, the bravado only comes out in the wrong time.

They think, the companies have not yet withdrawn.

And if the companies should come again.

They would wish they were in the desert among the Bedouins inquiring from a far about your news.

These Munafiqoon(منافقون), if the armies would attack Madina once again, they would wish that they were not in Madina and they were with the Bedouins

watching the news on their TV sets, listening to it on their radio sets.

They would wish they could hold the remote control in their hands and flip through the channels and listen to the news or watch the news about the Muslims,

but they don't want to be there.

Then Allah says; And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little.

These are signs of Nifaq(نفاق).

The Muslims were suffering hunger.

In Al-Bukhari(البخاريْ), Anas Ibn Malik(انس ابن مالك) said; "They would bring a handful of barley, and some ill smelling fat, as a meal for them,

hungry as they were, it struck in their throats, and smell bad.

So, what was the food.?

Some barley, and then they had animal fat, which was very old long expired, smell bad, it was rotten.

And they would swallow it and it would stick to the throat, you know how animal fat sticks to the throat, if you eat fat, especially if it's cold.

You know it sticks to your mouth and your teeth in the throat, and all.

And because it smelled bad they could still smell it.

But they were so hungry that they were eating this horrible food.

Al-Waqadie(الواقعدي) describes the situation that was going on and he talks about the fear that everybody was feeling the hunger that everyone was feeling,

the low spirits, especially because of what the Munafiqoon(منافقون) were doing bombarding the Muslims with only bad news.

And then you have this disaster coming from the quarters of Bannu Quraidha(بنوقريظه) the news that they have broken their agreement with Rasool Allah ﷺ, so it was very difficult.

And the Muslims had to work day and night, I mean, Muhammad Ibn Maslama(محمد ابن مسلمه) said; Our night during the Khandaq(خندق) was daytime,

meaning we had to work around the clock night was no different than day.

So, it was very stressful and you know when people are lacking sleep how they lose concentration and they fail to think straight.

So, Allah was testing them, Allah was testing them, to the limit.

Fighting did occur, you had duels you had enemy, trying to break through the trench from time to time, one incident that happened, a challenge to single combat was Amr Bin Abdu Woodh(عمرو بن عبد ود),

now Amr Bin Abdu Woodh(عمرو بن عبد ود) was one of the heroes of Quraish(قريش), strong powerful man.

So, he challenges the Muslims, send me forth, one of your men.

The one who went for it was Ali Bin Abi Talib(علي بن ابي طالب).

Amr(عمرو) ask him, Who are you.?

He said: I am Ali(علي).

He said Ali(علي), the son of Abdul Mannaf(عبدالمناف).

He said, No, I'm Ali(علي), the son of Abu Talib(ابو طالب).

He said, nephew.

There are among your uncle's, men who are more senior than you, more mature than you.

I feel sorry spilling your blood.

Ali Bin Abi Talib(علي بن ابي طالب) said: But I don't feel sorry spilling your blood.

Amr Bin Abdu Woodh(عمرو بن عبد ود) wanted somebody more senior to come and meet him stronger, with more experience.

And he said: I wouldn't want to spill your blood, my young nephew.

Ali Bin Abi Talib(علي بن ابي طالب) said: I would be very happy to spill yours.

So, Amr(عمرو) was very upset and Ibn Is'haaq(ابن اسحاق) said; He draws out his sword as if it was a brand of fire, and they exchanged blows.

And Amr(عمرو) strikes the shield of Ali Bin Abi Talib(علي بن ابي طالب), and the blow was so hard that the shield ended up hitting the head of Ali(علي)

that was how powerful it was, but on the other hand, because it was such a powerful blow the sword got stuck in the shield and Ali Bin Abi Talib(علي بن ابي طالب) struck Amr(عمرو) in the neck,

and he fell down dead, and the Sahabah(صحابه) made Takbeer(تكبير).

And that's when Rasool Allah ﷺ knew that Ali Bin Abi Talib(علي بن ابي طالب) won.

Sa'ad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعد ابن ابي وقاص) was a good marksman.

So, he had in his sights, this enemy soldier, who was holding two shields.

And it was sort of, you know, he was teasing the Muslims or what, but he would move down the shield a bit, so that the upper part of his head would show

and then he would cover it again and then pull it down, up and down, so Sa'ad(سعد) aims at the man and fires his shot, while the shield was down,

and it hits the man right in his forehead.

So, the man falls down and his legs go up.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ saw that and laughed, I mean, the way the man fell down was funny, so Rasool Allah ﷺ laughed.

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh رضي الله عنه, Ayesha(عائشه) said: He was a tall and large man.

And he was wearing armor but his arms were not covered.

So Ayesha(عائشه) said: When I saw him, I was really worried about his arms, and Subhaan Allah(سبحان الله), he was shot by an arrow in his arm.

And it cut the main vein or artery in his arm.

And he was seriously injured.

So, these were some of the skirmishes that happened during the Battle of Al-Khandaq(الخندق).
